title: Variant–Trait Claim Atlas: published variant–trait claims calibrated against genome-wide evidence
description: Atlas of 212,710 variant–trait claims read from 75,578 PubMed abstracts, each set against genome-wide significant associations in the NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog with a frequency-matched null; ClinVar risk variants with their genome-wide comparison; static lookup page; analysis code and dated analysis plan.
